text: At its meeting on June 6, 2022, the Film, Television and Digital Media Advisory Board considered Item FB12.2 and made a recommendation to the Economic and Community Development Committee. Summary from the report (May 20, 2022) from the Interim General Manager, Economic Development and Culture: As the Toronto Film, Television and Digital Media Board approaches the completion of its 2019-2022 term, it is required, as a Council Advisory Committee, to submit a report on its actions and accomplishments during the term. During the 2019 - 2022 term, the Toronto Film, Television and Digital Media Board focused its work on supporting and advising the advancement of the strategic pillars contained in Spotlight on Toronto: A Strategic Action Plan for the Film, Television and Digital Media Industry, a five-year strategy which was conceived and created in 2017 by the Toronto Film, Television and…
The Economic and Community Development Committee received the report (May 20, 2022) from the Interim General Manager, Economic Development and Culture for information.
